title: A DEAD SENTRY LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Sentry left the generic brown wreck shared by every machine. It now leaves its own wreck in its own palette: the scorched tread with a dead wheel row, the slumped hull with the ochre chevrons, the camera head snapped off with a dead black lens, the twin gun fallen on the ground, a bent mast. Smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Sentry leaves a smoking wreck of itself.
